shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated marks or patterning
stacked/registered placement of motifs on a stone surface
justification: The most specific correspondence is the use of linear, profile figures combined with horizontal patterned bands, with motifs arranged in stacked zones rather than as a single scene. The biggest difference is that A is a dense carved relief with bulky, integrated forms on a vertical block, while B is a much more open red-line painting/engraving with boat-like and fence-like forms spread across a flat rock surface.
